messages.subject: transition of outputs or results
parts:
I am developing an app with shiny googleVis. I have very big amount of data, it takes time before it does calculations so there's couple of problems I ran into. 

Suppose this app to be an example. You can see that it has a data printed out in the table. If you click on radio button the calculation appears and table becomes pageable.  However, you can notice that some time, after you pressed the radio button, the table remains unchanged. If you have lots of calculations this time becomes longer and sometimes it's hard to know whether your data already updated or no. 

So the question follows, is there any possibility to remove all outputs immediately if, for example, the slider value changes? Maybe it's possible to insert some kind of progress bar or processing bar.. 

Thank you in advance

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: transition of outputs or results
parts:
By default we attempt to change the opacity on any outputs that are recalculating (see example). If that's not what you want (or in this case, apparently not working on gvisTable), you can use the CSS class "recalculating" that is immediately added to any outputs that we know are going to be recomputed. You could add this to your ui.R (for example in the sidebarPanel or mainPanel) to hide recalculating outputs:

tags$style(type="text/css", ".recalculating {visibility: hidden}")

messages.author: c81ff89dde81dce8
messages.subject: Re: transition of outputs or results
parts: I don't think it is simply an issue of needing a progress bar. Shiny and googleVis don't seem to be playing well together (at least in the case of the gvisTable and renderGvis). You can see the (bad) behavior with the example app given by the OP. If you change the inputs repeatedly, you will eventually 'break' the app and no longer see a table displayed. It seems that it is not simply a matter of requiring additional time to recalculate the results, but rather that the table will not be displayed until the app is refreshed. I tried to replace the table for this app with a gvisTable (version with gvisTable is not publicly hosted), but encountered the same type of buggy behavior when changing the inputs.
